information.description:
The street's answer to a corporate cyberninja: a chrome blur that hunts the gang's toughest enemies. Light hitters, but good luck landing a blow.

Tyger Claws: Japantown's yakuza-style gang, blades, bikes and neon tattoos.

Stat block from Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis, unofficial content under R. Talsorian Games' Homebrew Content Policy. Portrait: Neon Hub fan art of the Cyberpunk 2077 setting (CD PROJEKT RED), free to use, not for sale.

description.value:
Martial Arts (×2) is learned one Form at a time; each Form is its own Skill. Martial Arts Attacks are ROF2, ignore half armor and deal Brawling damage by BODY. Every Form has two Special Moves, and all Forms share Recovery.

Special Moves

  • Armor Breaking Combination: Hit one target with a Melee Weapon and a MA Attack this Turn. DV15: all their worn armor ablates 2 more.
  • Bone Breaking Strike: WILL 8+. Instead of 2 attacks, one MA Special Move attack: on a hit add Broken Ribs; at −8 vs the head, Cracked Skull instead.

Special Move resolution: DEX + Form Skill + 1d10 vs the target's DEX + Evasion + 1d10, or the DV listed. Special Moves can't be Aimed Shots unless they say so. "Once per Turn" means once per your Turn.

Recovery (shared): when you use Get Up, beat DV13 and it costs no Action. Not with a Broken or Dismembered Leg.
